history.summary: A 355 sqft freehold shoebox 1BR in Balestier/D12 at $1,972 psf, far (1.13km) from Toa Payoh MRT, with no URA data to validate pricing. Tiny format, high PSF, weak transit and a weak arena record (Elo 952) make this a low-conviction Avoid for investment.
history.rating_rationale: 355 sqft is a true shoebox with the most volatile resale demand and a high $1,972 psf despite a poor 1.13km MRT walk; there is no URA series to confirm the asking price is supportable. Balestier shoeboxes have lagged on capital growth, and the arena record (91-214-10, Elo 952) confirms a weak competitive profile. Freehold and a low $700K quantum are the only positives.
red_flags: 355 sqft shoebox — most cyclical, narrowest resale demand
High $1,972 psf for the format with no URA validation
1.13km / 14-min walk to MRT — weak transit anchor
catalysts: Low $700K quantum and central Balestier location keep it lettable
